attempts.sql: WITH RECURSIVE api_model AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols WHERE kind = 'class' AND (name = 'ApiModel' OR qualname = 'ApiModel')), inheritance_chain AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, cb.base_symbol_id, 1 AS depth FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN api_model AS am ON cb.base_symbol_id = am.symbol_id UNION ALL SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, cb.base_symbol_id, ic.depth + 1 FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN inheritance_chain AS ic ON cb.base_symbol_id = ic.class_symbol_id WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT base_symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases)) SELECT class_symbol_id, MIN(depth) AS depth FROM inheritance_chain GROUP BY class_symbol_id HAVING MIN(depth) >= 2 ORDER BY class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query identifies classes that inherit from ApiModel indirectly through at least one intermediate class and computes the shortest inheritance chain depth. It uses a recursive CTE starting from ApiModel's direct bases in symbols, then recursively traces class_bases to build the inheritance chain, computing depth at each step. The final SELECT groups by class_symbol_id, takes the minimum depth per class, filters for depth >= 2 (ensuring only indirect inheritance is returned), and orders by class_symbol_id. The result provides each qualifying class's symbol ID and its shortest chain length to ApiModel.
sql: WITH RECURSIVE api_model AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols WHERE kind = 'class' AND (name = 'ApiModel' OR qualname = 'ApiModel')), inheritance_chain AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, cb.base_symbol_id, 1 AS depth FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN api_model AS am ON cb.base_symbol_id = am.symbol_id UNION ALL SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, cb.base_symbol_id, ic.depth + 1 FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN inheritance_chain AS ic ON cb.base_symbol_id = ic.class_symbol_id WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT base_symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases)) SELECT class_symbol_id, MIN(depth) AS depth FROM inheritance_chain GROUP BY class_symbol_id HAVING MIN(depth) >= 2 ORDER BY class_symbol_id
